unit.label: Displayed unit
unit.description: Unit of the value next to the bar. The bar always follows the percentage.

value_position.label: Value position
value_position.description: Where the value is shown relative to the bar.

show_icon.label: Show icon
show_icon.description: Show an icon in front of the bar.

sources.title: Sources
sources.mode_auto: Sensors detected automatically from the Grohe device
sources.mode_none: No sensors detected — assign them manually

edge_content.label: Edge content
edge_content.description: What is shown at the edge next to each bar.

tap_action.label: Tap action
tap_action.description: What happens when you tap the bar. More info opens the sensor in the selected unit.

hold_reset.label: Reset on hold
hold_reset.description: Long-press the bar to reset the counter after replacing the CO₂ cylinder or the filter. Asks for confirmation.

reset_confirm.co2: Reset the CO₂ counter? Do this only after replacing the CO₂ cylinder.
reset_confirm.filter: Reset the filter counter? Do this only after replacing the filter.
